cards.title: Small fixes skip the ceremony
cards.description: As a founder, I can start a one-line fix and watch it go straight to build and verify, so that the pipeline matches the size of the work. Initiative: founder ships without ceremony · M · metric: cycle time, trivial cards
cards.dedupe: build:docs/story-standard.md:Small fixes skip the ceremony

events.note: Q1: Skip research, spec and the spec gate; keep build, verify (local gate) and review (pr gate). Prod gate unchanged. Splitting and epics stay in c-060.
reconciled 10-11: back to the plan; work continues under the new stories

Q2: Agent proposes `size:` in the investigate stage; founder can override with `card new --size`; a trivial sizing is shown in the local gate note ("size: trivial, skipped research/spec") so Dean sees it once.

Q3: Dogfood on a real one-line fix in codeloop. Given a card sized trivial, when `codeloop run`, then no research.md or spec.md exists, events show create -> build -> verify in one run, and `codeloop stats` shows trivial cycle time under one hour.
Q4: Hard cap: trivial = at most 3 files and 50 changed lines, enforced by `check diff` at verify; over the cap the card is re-sized to S and parked at the spec gate.
Q5: Add `trivial` as a fourth size (one row in the story standard); stages carry `when: size >= S` in build.yaml.

story.can: start a one-line fix and watch it go straight to build and verify
story.so: the pipeline matches the size of the work

cards.title: Park ideas in a backlog

events.note: Q1: Column and propose-beyond-WIP only. `--as` goes as a task under c-088 (roles); `serve --bg` as a task under c-062.
Q1: Column and propose-beyond-WIP only. `--as` goes as a task under c-088 (roles); `serve --bg` as a task under c-062.
Q2: Both. `run` pulls the top-RICE backlog card when a slot frees (createdAt order until c-061 ships); `card start <id>` jumps the queue.
Q3: Given WIP=2 with two cards in build, when `card propose` a third, then it sits in `backlog` on `serve`, the inbox counts it under parked, and `run` leaves it there until a slot frees.
Q4: Age it, never drop: inbox prints "N in backlog, oldest 21d"; the plan lane's Monday rank is the only thing that reorders it.
Q5: One column: rename stage `proposed` to `backlog`; scan proposals and founder parkings sit together, sorted by rice.

Q1: Git and GitHub PR only. Live = merge commit reachable from `prodRef` (a tag or branch in config). Fly/Vercel detection belongs to c-073.
Q2: we need some local git branch script/hook for this? or should ask user if cant be found?

Q4: interesting question - we should have the acceptance criteria matching (criteria is created at the start of the card)
Q5: Polling via `gh pr view` in `run` and `watch`; a webhook is c-087/c-088 territory.

Q4: The hosted card page when cloud sync is on; otherwise the `serve --bg` localhost URL plus a three-line evidence summary pasted into the message so it reads without the link.
